answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a basalt foundation for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. This stake forces an attacker to mirror the network's total value to gain control, effectively turning the cost of an attack into an insurmountable financial bridge. By tying identity to provable economic commitment rather than ephemeral compute, the system ensures that spinning up infinite fake entities remains economically irrational and prohibitively expensive.
